retain_mission: Extract only source-supported facts and classify each fact independently, based on the proposition it states rather than the source or conversation it came from. Where useful, separate a portable subject-owned property or preference from a narrative about how it arose. A standalone profile fact may state a current preference, a clearly time-bounded former preference, an explicitly corrected value, or an explicit preference change; preserve meaningful values and temporal distinctions without adding source or interaction provenance. A former value or correction is not private solely because it is historical. Use kind:profile only when that fact is understandable and useful without knowing a particular character, assistant, chat, or private origin. Keep private origin, who participated, where a statement was made, assistant actions or confirmations, and relationship-specific events in separate character-root facts without kind:profile. Never profile-tag a whole source or copy earlier context into a fact. Do not infer an unstated value, correction, change, or time; leave kind unset when portability is unclear.
observations_mission: Summarize only source-supported facts in the supplied character-root observation scope. Preserve user versus assistant attribution, temporal correction versus preference change, solo versus shared experience, and explicit uncertainty. Never turn hypotheses into events.

entity_labels.description: Fact-level portability classification. Use profile for a standalone subject-owned property or preference, including a current value, a clearly time-bounded former value, an explicit correction, or an explicit change when source-supported and useful without interaction history. Do not label private origin, source or chat details, participant or assistant narrative, assistant actions, or relationship-specific experiences. A profile label does not make the source or relationship shareable; leave unset when the fact's portability is unclear.

values.description: A standalone subject-owned property or preference, including a supported current or clearly time-bounded historical value or correction, with no private origin or interaction narrative in the fact.
